# robotFloatingBaseTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [robotFloatingBaseTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/robotFloatingBaseTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  Robot.CreateKinematicTree with a floating base (#3359): QuadrupedANYmalB, a tree of 12 joints, falling freely with its joints held by their PD control at
#           the configuration of the model: the base follows the parabola of free fall exactly, as the gravity does not bend the legs of a free body, and the
#           total center of mass of the robot as well; run directly, the SolutionViewer shows the fall
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-11-09
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import *
from exudyn.robotics import RobotBase
from exudyn.robotics.models import QuadrupedANYmalB, LinkDict2Robot
import numpy as np

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)

SC = exu.SystemContainer()
mbs = SC.AddSystem()

model = QuadrupedANYmalB()
robot = LinkDict2Robot(model, initialConfiguration='model')
base = model['baseInertia']
z0 = 1.
robot.base = RobotBase(HT=exu.HT(translation=[0, 0, z0]))
inertia = RigidBodyInertia(mass=base['mass'], inertiaTensor=base['inertia'], com=base['COM'], inertiaTensorAtCOM=True)
tree = robot.CreateKinematicTree(mbs, floatingBase=inertia)

checks = [tree['nodeBase'] is not None, int(mbs.GetObject(tree['objectKinematicTree'])['baseNodeNumber']) == int(tree['nodeBase'])]
sensor = mbs.AddSensor(SensorNode(nodeNumber=tree['nodeBase'], storeInternal=True, outputVariableType=exu.OutputVariableType.Position))
mbs.Assemble()

tEnd = 0.2
simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 200
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = tEnd
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
simulationSettings.solution.file.write = not testIsActive
mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings, showHints=False)

z = mbs.GetSensorStoredData(sensor)[-1, 3]
g = -model['gravity'][2]
exu.Print('height', z, 'free fall', z0 - 0.5*g*tEnd**2)
checks += [abs(z - (z0 - 0.5*g*tEnd**2)) < 1e-3]
joints = mbs.GetNodeOutput(tree['nodeGeneric'], exu.OutputVariableType.Coordinates)
checks += [np.max(np.abs(np.array(joints) - np.array(robot.q0))) < 1e-3] #the legs are held

if not testIsActive:
    mbs.SolutionViewer()

u = sum(checks) + z
exu.Print('checks:', checks)
exu.Print('solution of robotFloatingBaseTest=', u)
exu.sys['testResult'] = u
exu.sys['testTolerance'] = 1e-10
```
